_doc: SIMLI_WIREUP §6 / R4-M7 — source-controlled Sentry alert config. Apply via `sentry-cli alerts apply sentry/alerts/lipsync.json` after `sentry-cli login` (deferred to follow-up if not yet wired in CI). Until then, configure these by hand in the Sentry UI to match.
_two_metrics: We track TWO related metrics (R2-M5 / R4-S clarification): `simli_lipsync_latency_ms` (bridge t1 → first video frame; Simli-health) feeds the 1200ms regression alert. `user_perceived_response_ms` (mic-tap-release → first audio_out; UX) feeds the Phase-E 800ms ship gate but does NOT page on alert (UX measurement, not infrastructure failure).

alerts.name: simli_lipsync_latency_p95_regression
alerts.comment: Floor of 10 sessions/10min prevents single-user noise from paging on day-1 traffic.

alerts.name: simli_video_paused_with_track_high
alerts.comment: R4-YC-Day demo-day failure mode. >2% rate = iOS autoplay rebind regression.

alerts.name: simli_clock_drift_p95_regression
alerts.comment: Threshold raised from R3 200ms to 400ms (above Cartesia's own 187.5ms chunk cadence — R4-S).

alerts.name: simli_mint_replica_not_found_high
alerts.comment: GDPR-erasure / force-retrain race surfaces as replica_not_found mid-session. >3 in 10min = a worker-vs-session race we missed.

alerts.name: proxy_session_evicted_high
alerts.comment: Single-WS-per-session enforcement (R4-C1) evicted the prior tab's WS. Fires on the OLD client as the {type:'error',code:'session_evicted'} text frame at server/voice-proxy/index.js:490 — surfaces the iOS Safari WS-close-then-reconnect race per memory `project_ios_4002_reconnect`. The pre-session 4002 close on the NEW client is silent today (no captureSafe('ws_close',...) at use-session-pipe.ts:769); coverage of that side waits on Phase C punch-list B1.3.

alerts.name: proxy_quota_state_inconsistent_any
alerts.comment: P0002 from voice_check_quota / voice_accumulate_seconds OR R4-C2 22003 oob — real consistency bug, never a cap hit. Any occurrence pages.

alerts.name: proxy_kill_switch_fired_high
alerts.comment: 150% daily-cap latch fired (sessions_enforce_tier_and_kill_switch trigger). Per-user it is rare-by-design. >3/hr across users = pricing math drift or trigger misconfig. Coverage = MID-SESSION ONLY: turn_start gate at server/voice-proxy/index.js:928 emits {type:'error',code:'kill_switch_fired'} which use-session-pipe.ts:641 captures as `proxy_kill_switch_fired`. Pre-session 4003 close at server/voice-proxy/index.js:469 is silent today; that side waits on Phase C punch-list B1.3.

alerts.name: user_ws_backpressure_cap_high
alerts.comment: User WS bufferedAmount > 2 MB (R3-C2). One-off = bad network; sustained = relay loop not draining. Captured at server/voice-proxy/index.js:721 as bare `user_ws_backpressure_cap` (no `proxy_` prefix because it's a server-side, not client-side, capture).
